subtopic: Investor Risks from Limited Public Information
source_evidence: Investing in these companies is riskier as there can be little public information to allow investors to make an informed investment decision.
answer: Limited public information can make it harder for investors to assess a company before investing. Some companies’ securities trade on smaller public markets even though those companies do not regularly report business and financial information to the public. The source describes investing in these companies as riskier because investors may have too little information to make an informed decision.
